## Load Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")
library("here") 
```

## Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
biopsy_url <- "https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv"
biopsy_data_file <- file.path(data_dir, "biopsy.csv")
if(!dir.exists(data_dir)) {
    dir.create(path = data_dir)
  }

if(file.exists(biopsy_data_file)) {
    biopsy_data <- read_csv(file = biopsy_data_file, 
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else {
    print("Retriving data")
    biopsy_data <- read_csv(file = biopsy_url,
                            show_col_types = FALSE)
    write_csv(x = biopsy_data, file = biopsy_data_file)
  }
```

## Analysis

### Applying PCA model

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy_data |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```

### 2D data representation in PC coordinates

```{r}
# Extract explained variance for PC1 and PC2
explained_var <- pca_fit |> 
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues") |> 
  select(1, 2) |> 
  pluck(percent)

# 2D scatter plot of data projected onto the two major principle components
pca_fit |> 
  augment(biopsy) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1,
             y = .fittedPC2,
             color = outcome,
             shape = outcome)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5,
             alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       title = "Breast cancer biopsy data projected on PCs")
```
